Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier portal invite (blank page)

Looping in findings from initial log check — we see the SAML handshake succeed but the RelayState value is being truncated by an intermediate redirector on the vendor side (RelayState > 255 chars), which causes the portal router to drop the session and return a blank page. This is neither Okta nor our IdP failing — it's the URL rewrite in the corporate proxy chain.

Short-term fixes:
1) Manual activation: I generated a one-time activation token you can use now. Link expires in 6 hours. (Sent as a stub below.)
2) Email link alternative: use the /accept?token=<token> path instead of going through SAML RelayState.
3) Long-term: vendor proxy needs to allow RelayState passthrough or we strip RelayState and map by secure server-side cookie.

I've opened HUBSPOT case HS-98231 and sent a ticket to Infra (INFRA-5174).

Manual activation token: https://redwood.ai/manual-activate?token=MAN-ACT-7b9c2a

Ben Carter
Platform Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: manual-activation-link.txt (text)
